title: auto_docstring prints [ERROR] doc-lint diagnostics to stdout at import time
author: CalamitousFelicitousness

comments.author: zucchini-nlp
comments.body:
The log printing at import time is kinda expected and should be delayed to later after https://github.com/huggingface/transformers/pull/45056 is merged

Though it's interesting you see errors on missing args. I added recently support for merging docs from parent classes and re-checking now on `main` branch, I can't reproduce it. Could be related to python version and how dataclasses get resolved 🤔  
I am using python 3.10, but let me get 3.13 and check again

comments.author: zucchini-nlp
comments.body: Ah it was fixed on main, I forgot that I merged it recently. Closing as resolved then
